property.name: yarn.resourcemanager.hostname
property.description: ResourceManager host — the single authority for cluster containers.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.resource.memory-mb
property.description: Memory each NodeManager may offer as containers (~80% of 32 GB).

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.resource.cpu-vcores
property.description: vCores each NodeManager advertises for container scheduling.

property.name: yarn.scheduler.minimum-allocation-mb
property.description: Smallest container the scheduler will grant (1 GB).

property.name: yarn.scheduler.maximum-allocation-mb
property.description: Largest container (16 GB) — bounds runaway Spark driver requests.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.vmem-check-enabled
property.description: Disable strict virtual-memory checks; required for Spark/JVM workloads.

property.name: yarn.log-aggregation-enable
property.description: Aggregate container logs into HDFS so they outlive the container.
